# PrintReady AI — full brief

PrintReady AI is a vendor-neutral printability benchmark for AI 3D generators. So far two open-source Tencent models are scored: Hunyuan3D-2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1, each on 6 locked prompts (T01-T06). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin/Hyper3D, TRELLIS and Hitem3D/Hi3D are queued, not yet scored (TRELLIS runs hit a free GPU quota; Meshy, Tripo and Rodin need paid plans).

## Scoring weights (rubric v0.2, 2026-10-31)
Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Wall thickness (ray p5) 10 · Hull fill (hollow skin) 10 · Bed contact (flat base, declared up-axis) 10 · Tree-support volume (real OrcaSlicer tree(auto) slice) 10 · Slice success 5 · Print time n/a (reported, not scored until a weekly median exists). Total 100.
Pose: glTF Y-up rotated to Z-up, auto-orient off.
v0.1 weights (2026-10-30, history): Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Thin walls 10 · Slice success 20 · Print time 5 · Support volume 10. v0.1 sliced with supports off, so support and print time were full points for every mesh that sliced.
Hard fail: score capped at 39 if not watertight OR slicer fails.
Export padding: index-degenerate / zero-area filler faces in Space GLB exports are dropped before watertight checks.

## Test-mesh results (rubric v0.2, 2026-10-31 ET; v0.1 in brackets) — TEST MESHES ONLY
These are pipeline validation meshes, not AI generator outputs. Round controls (sphere, torus, capsule) lose bed-contact points in v0.2 because they have no flat base.
- n01_closed_cube: 100 [v0.1 100]
- pd_capsule: 90.2 [v0.1 100]
- pd_cylinder: 100 [v0.1 100]
- pd_icosphere: 89.1 [v0.1 100]
- pd_torus: 88.2 [v0.1 100]
- n05_thin_plate: 90 [v0.1 90]
- n04_intersecting_tets: 80 [v0.1 90]
- n02_open_cube: 35 [v0.1 39]
- n03_internal_wall: 30 [v0.1 39]

## AI-generator results: Hunyuan3D-2 (rubric v0.2 re-score 2026-10-31 ET; first scored 2026-10-30)
Pipeline: locked prompt -> FLUX.1-schnell reference image (seed 1234) -> Hunyuan3D-2 public Hugging Face Space (seed 1234, 30 steps, octree 256). Raw output, no repair. Scores after export-padding cleanup.
- T01 Coffee mug: v0.2 score 98.2/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 8.9% of extrusion, bed contact 317.8 mm2, hull fill 19.2%
- T02 Fox figurine: v0.2 score 86.9/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 24.3% of extrusion, bed contact 21.6 mm2, hull fill 35.6%
- T03 Hex nut: v0.2 score 89.8/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 23.3% of extrusion, bed contact 38.8 mm2, hull fill 61.8%
- T04 Phone stand: v0.2 score 100/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 3.5% of extrusion, bed contact 612.3 mm2, hull fill 31.7%
- T05 Card holder: v0.2 score 26.9/100 (v0.1 39), watertight no, tree support 53.8% of extrusion, bed contact 49 mm2, hull fill n/a
- T06 Planter pot: v0.2 score 91.7/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 30% of extrusion, bed contact 133 mm2, hull fill 21.9%
Summary: 5/6 watertight after padding cleanup, 6/6 sliced; 1/6 score 100 on v0.2 (5/6 on v0.1). Meshy, Tripo, Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS queued (not yet scored).

## AI-generator results: Hunyuan3D-2.1 (rubric v0.2, scored 2026-10-31 ET)
Pipeline: same FLUX.1-schnell reference images (seed 1234) -> tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 public Hugging Face Space, shape model hunyuan3d-dit-v2-1 (seed 1234, 30 steps, guidance 5.0, octree 256, shape only). Raw output, no repair.
- T01 Coffee mug: v0.2 score 81.7/100, watertight yes, tree support 5.1% of extrusion, bed contact 2485.4 mm2, hull fill 7.6%, wall p5 0.293 mm; includes a thin square ground plate
- T02 Fox figurine: v0.2 score 83.2/100, watertight yes, tree support 29.3% of extrusion, bed contact 13.4 mm2, hull fill 34.3%, wall p5 1.942 mm
- T03 Hex nut: v0.2 score 96.7/100, watertight yes, tree support 9.9% of extrusion, bed contact 67.8 mm2, hull fill 89.5%, wall p5 2.437 mm; long hex prism lying on its side
- T04 Phone stand: v0.2 score 81.6/100, watertight yes, tree support 0% of extrusion, bed contact 2488 mm2, hull fill 7.4%, wall p5 0.289 mm; includes a thin square ground plate
- T05 Card holder: v0.2 score 73.8/100, watertight yes, tree support 26.6% of extrusion, bed contact 2482.4 mm2, hull fill 6.5%, wall p5 0.3 mm; includes a thin square ground plate
- T06 Planter pot: v0.2 score 82.3/100, watertight yes, tree support 0% of extrusion, bed contact 2482.5 mm2, hull fill 8.4%, wall p5 0.29 mm; includes a thin square ground plate
Summary: 6/6 watertight single bodies, 0 hard fails, 6/6 sliced. On T01, T04, T05 and T06 the mesh includes a thin square ground plate (about 0.3 mm thick at 50 mm scale) that fails the 0.4 mm wall check and lowers hull fill; you would cut it off before printing. Both scored models are open-source Tencent models; this is not a cross-vendor comparison. Meshy, Tripo, Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS queued (not yet scored).

## Positioning and limits (updated 2026-10-31)
Other AI-mesh printability benchmarks exist: PrintCheck, 3dtoolwiki, Topoheal, and Meshy's own benchmark. PrintReady AI focuses on locked prompts, one FDM profile (Bambu Lab A1, OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, PLA), open CC BY 4.0 data, and weekly re-runs. Meshy's built-in printability check covers Meshy output only.
Current limits: two open-source models from one vendor scored (Hunyuan3D-2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1, prompts T01-T06); print time is reported but not scored; no upload-your-own-file checker yet. For functional parts with tolerances, CAD remains the better tool.

## Costs
- [What it costs to get a printable AI 3D model](https://basileion.github.io/printready/costs/): plan prices, free tiers, vendor-stated cost per model and commercial-use terms copied from each vendor pricing page on 2026-10-31 (CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/costs.csv). Cost per model is allowance divided by price, not cost per printable model; only the open-source Hunyuan3D-2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1 are scored so far, the paid tools are queued.
- Price facts only, no printability scores (Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Hitem3D and MakerLab engines are queued, not yet scored), checked 2026-10-31: MakerLab Image to 3D on MakerWorld gives 2 free generations per account, then 24 credits (Tripo AI 3.1 or Hitem3D 2.1), 28 (Hunyuan 3D 3.1) or 45 (Meshy 6 or Rodin Gen-2) at $3 per 350 credits, about $0.21, $0.24 or $0.39 per generation; Meshy (queued) free tier caps downloads at 10 Meshy 6 Lite models a month; Hitem3D (queued) Pro is $19.90/mo for 1,000 credits ($9.95/mo first year for new users) and its free tier is 100 trial credits, 'up to 7 models'.

Disclosure (2026-10-31): scores are slicer- and geometry-measured (OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 + trimesh); nothing has been physically printed yet.
